title: Integration by parts for Lipschitz functions against C^1_c fields supported in the ball
statement:
Let n ∈ ℕ, R ∈ ℝ, B := B̆_R(0) ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n), e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1, and D = fderiv ℝ (so Du(x) = 0 at points where u is not differentiable). Let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ be Lipschitz. Let Φ_0, …, Φ_{n−1} : ℝⁿ → ℝ be C¹, each with compact support and tsupport Φ_i ⊆ B. Then
∫_B Σ_i Du(x)(e_i)·Φ_i(x) dx = −∫_B u(x)·Σ_i DΦ_i(x)(e_i) dx.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (Φ : Fin n → Euclid n → ℝ), (∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L u) → (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ i)) → (∀ i, HasCompactSupport (Φ i)) → (∀ i, tsupport (Φ i) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R) → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * Φ i x = -∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, u x * ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))
